name: The Chill of Death
summary: In Brill, The Chill of Death weighs on Gretchen Dedmar as she fights the cold of undeath. The Forsaken tailor fears losing her mind and her service to Lady Sylvanas, so she asks for materials to sew a warm blanket.

sections.title: A Creeping Frost
sections.body: Gretchen Dedmar feels the Plague of Undeath like an icy serpent moving through her body. The chill drains warmth from her limbs and threatens to leave her mindless, like the wandering corpses in Tirisfal Glades. Her shaking hands make even ordinary work difficult.

sections.title: Service to the Dark Lady
sections.body: Gretchen will not abandon her duty to the Forsaken kingdom. When Sylvanas Windrunner first rallied the liberated dead, Gretchen sewed burial shrouds and body bags for fallen soldiers. Sturdy duskbat pelts and coarse thread can help her make a blanket. Its warmth may steady her hands enough to keep serving the Forsaken cause.

faq.answer: Gretchen Dedmar is a Forsaken tailor who lives in Brill. She once sewed body bags for Lady Sylvanas's fallen troops.

faq.q: What is the 'Mindless State' Gretchen fears?
aliases: why is gretchen losing her mind
faq.answer: The mindless state is the mental and physical decay that overtakes some undead when their will and necrotic energies fail. They become feral, shambling creatures like those wandering outside Brill and Deathknell.

faq.q: Why does Gretchen feel cold if she is dead?
faq.answer: Gretchen feels the plague in her veins as a freezing chill. It stiffens her joints and leaves her hands shaking, though she is undead.

faq.q: Why does she need duskbat pelts and thread?
faq.answer: Gretchen needs five duskbat pelts and coarse thread to sew a thick blanket. She hopes its warmth will steady her hands so she can keep working.
Duskbats roost in the woods and open glades around Brill and northern Tirisfal.

faq.q: Does this quest connect to any other duties in Brill?
faq.answer: Gretchen's need for aid is a concern of her own among Brill's residents. It shows the quiet, personal struggles of the newly liberated Forsaken.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, Gretchen's struggle reminds you that freedom from the Lich King does not stop physical rot or the threat of mindlessness.
As a tailor, you can see how Gretchen's needlework has changed from sewing body bags for Sylvanas's army to making a blanket from pelts.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Chill of Death
